# PlayStation
> Official PlayStation web presence for consoles, games, services, support, and account management.

PlayStation.net and related PlayStation web properties provide access to PlayStation hardware information, PlayStation Store, PlayStation Plus, support resources, account services, and official news for the PlayStation ecosystem.

## Main
- [PlayStation Home](https://www.playstation.com/): Official PlayStation homepage for consoles, games, services, and featured announcements.
- [Games](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/): Browse PlayStation games, exclusives, releases, and platform-specific game hubs.
- [PS5](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps5/): Overview of PlayStation 5 hardware, features, accessories, and games.
- [PS4](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps4/): Information about PlayStation 4 consoles, features, and supported games.
- [Accessories](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/accessories/): Official PlayStation accessories including controllers, audio, storage, and peripherals.
- [PlayStation Plus](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps-plus/): Subscription service details, benefits, game catalog, and membership tiers.
- [PlayStation Store](https://store.playstation.com/): Digital storefront for games, add-ons, subscriptions, and media content.

## Hardware
- [PS5 Console](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps5/): Core PlayStation 5 console information, features, and buying guidance.
- [PS5 Pro](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps5/ps5-pro/): Details on the enhanced PS5 Pro console and performance features.
- [PS5 Digital Edition](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps5/): Digital-only PS5 hardware information and capabilities.
- [PS4 Console](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps4/): PlayStation 4 hardware overview and ecosystem information.
- [DualSense Wireless Controller](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/accessories/dualsense-wireless-controller/): Official DualSense controller features, colors, and compatibility information.
- [PlayStation VR2](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps-vr2/): Next-generation PlayStation VR headset details, features, and supported experiences.
- [Pulse Elite Wireless Headset](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/accessories/pulse-elite-wireless-headset/): Official wireless headset information, features, and audio capabilities.

## Services
- [PlayStation Plus](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps-plus/): Membership plans, monthly games, online multiplayer, and catalog benefits.
- [PlayStation Stars](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/playstation-stars/): Loyalty program information, campaigns, rewards, and collectibles.
- [Remote Play](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/remote-play/): Stream PlayStation games to supported devices over local or remote connections.
- [PlayStation App](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/playstation-app/): Mobile app for messaging, downloads, store access, and account management.
- [PlayStation Store](https://store.playstation.com/): Purchase and manage digital games, add-ons, and subscriptions.
- [PlayStation Network](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/playstation-network/): Overview of PSN services, connectivity, and account-linked features.

## Account and Security
- [Account Management](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/): Support resources for sign-in, profile, family, and account settings.
- [Sign In](https://my.account.sony.com/): Sony account sign-in portal used for PlayStation account access.
- [Create an Account](https://my.account.sony.com/): Sony account registration and authentication entry point.
- [Password Reset Support](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/password-reset-psn/): Help for resetting PlayStation Network account passwords.
- [2-Step Verification](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/2sv-psn-login/): Guidance for enabling and troubleshooting account two-step verification.
- [Family Management](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/playstation-family-account-set-up/): Set up family accounts, guardians, and child account controls.
- [Privacy Settings](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/ps5-manage-privacy-settings/): Manage privacy and visibility settings on PlayStation systems.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/): Central PlayStation support hub for hardware, account, and store issues.
- [PS5 Support](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/hardware/ps5/): Troubleshooting and setup help for PlayStation 5 consoles and accessories.
- [PS4 Support](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/hardware/ps4/): Troubleshooting and setup help for PlayStation 4 consoles and accessories.
- [PlayStation Store Support](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/store/): Help with purchases, downloads, refunds, and payment methods.
- [Account Support](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/): Assistance for login, security, family, and profile management.
- [Hardware Repairs](https://repairs.playstation.com/): Repair and replacement service portal for eligible PlayStation hardware.
- [Support Videos](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/videos/): Official support video guides for setup and troubleshooting tasks.

## Games and Store
- [All Games](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/): Browse PlayStation game hubs, genres, and featured releases.
- [PlayStation Indies](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/indies/): Discover indie titles and curated independent game highlights.
- [Free to Play](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/free-to-play/): Collection of free-to-play games available on PlayStation platforms.
- [Deals and Discounts](https://store.playstation.com/en-us/pages/deals): Current PlayStation Store promotions, discounts, and featured sales.
- [PS Store Collections](https://store.playstation.com/en-us/category/): Browse curated categories and collections in PlayStation Store.
- [Redeem Codes](https://store.playstation.com/en-us/redeem): Redeem PlayStation Store vouchers, wallet codes, and promotional codes.

## News and Editorial
- [PlayStation Blog](https://blog.playstation.com/): Official editorial site for announcements, updates, interviews, and feature stories.
- [PS Blog News](https://blog.playstation.com/category/news/): News posts covering product announcements and platform updates.
- [PS Blog Games](https://blog.playstation.com/category/games/): Articles focused on game reveals, launches, and developer insights.
- [PS Blog PS5](https://blog.playstation.com/category/ps5/): PS5-specific news, features, and platform-related updates.
- [PS Blog PlayStation VR2](https://blog.playstation.com/category/playstation-vr2/): News and features related to PlayStation VR2 hardware and games.
- [PS Blog PlayStation Plus](https://blog.playstation.com/category/playstation-plus/): Subscription announcements, monthly games, and catalog updates.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/psn-terms-of-service/): Terms governing PlayStation Network use and related services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices for PlayStation websites, services, and accounts.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/cookies/): Information about cookie usage and related controls.
- [Software Usage Terms](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/software-usage-terms/): Terms covering software licenses and usage restrictions.
- [Health Warning](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/health-warning/): Safety and health information for PlayStation product usage.
- [Website Terms of Use](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/legal/website-terms-of-use/): Terms governing access to and use of PlayStation websites.

## Developers and Partners
- [PlayStation Partners](https://partners.playstation.net/): Official portal for game developers and publishing partners.
- [Register Interest](https://partners.playstation.net/): Entry point for studios seeking PlayStation partner access.
- [Sony Interactive Entertainment](https://www.sie.com/en/): Corporate site for Sony Interactive Entertainment organization and business information.
- [Press Releases](https://www.sie.com/en/news/): Official Sony Interactive Entertainment news and press announcements.
